newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Investcorp gets $400 mln revolving credit.
newsitem.headline: Investcorp gets $400 mln revolving credit.

text.p: Investcorp, an international investment bank based in Bahrain, said it had signed a $400 million revolving credit facility with international banks.
The deal was signed by Luxembourg-based Investcorp SA, the principle financial entity of Investcorp, a bank statement said.
Investcorp will use the credit to meet periodic temporary funding requirements without reducing the size of its short-term liquid investment programmes, it said.
The five-year credit was raised to $400 million from $250 million because of substantial oversubscription.

"We are delighted with the support we have received for this facility. Investcorp's sound financial performance and credit strength is reflected in the quality and international standing of the banks in the syndication," chief financial officer Gary Long said.
Lead managers of the syndication were Commercial Bank of Kuwait, Mitsui Trust & Banking Co Ltd and MashreqBank of the United Arab Emirates.
